line.a_zima.text: Brr, winter is coming! I must gather a store for the winter. I need lots of food, many nuts!

line.a_duzo.text: Squirrel, look! I brought you a lot of food!

line.a_jedna.text: Fox, that is one pumpkin. Big, but just one.

line.a_co_wiele.text: Just one? Then what does many mean?

line.a_wiele.text: Many is when there are lots of things. Look at the nuts: this one, and this, and this, and this...

line.a_nazwa.text: There is one pumpkin. And there are many nuts.

line.a_gdzie_jedna.text: Now you. Where is one thing? Point to it.

line.a_to_wiele.text: There are many nuts here. And where is there just one?

line.a_gdzie_wiele.text: And where are many things? Point to them.

line.a_to_jedna.text: That is one pumpkin. And where are many things?

line.a_zbiory.text: There is still a lot of harvest in the garden. Will you help me put it away?

line.a_sortuj.text: If there is one of something, put it on the plate. If there are many, put them in the basket. Drag every thing.

line.a_pomylka.text: Look again: is it one thing, or are there many?

line.a_dynia_tez.text: Then my pumpkin goes into the store too! One huge pumpkin and many nuts.

line.a_do_strumyka.text: Hooray! And now let's go to the brook for water.

line.b_kaczka.text: Oh dear, look! Mother Duck is very worried.

line.b_wiele_brak.text: Mother Duck has many ducklings. They all came back from swimming... but one is missing!

line.b_gdzie.text: Let's look for it! Where is one duckling, all alone? Point to it.

line.b_to_wiele.text: There are many ducklings here. We are looking for the one that is alone.

line.b_jest.text: There it is! One duckling hid in the reeds.

line.b_dziekuje.text: Now all the ducklings are together. Mother Duck says thank you!

line.b_zabawa.text: The ducklings want to play hide and seek with you! Catch the duckling when it pops up.

line.b_do_domu.text: That was fun! Now we go home with the store. We'll have a feast!

line.p_start.text: Before we eat, let's check my store! I have five games for you.

line.p_ile_razy.text: Did I clap once or many times? Point to the card.

line.p_wiele_razy.text: Many times! Clap, clap, clap, and more, and more.

line.p_kubki.text: Under one cup I hide one acorn, and under the other many acorns. Watch carefully!

line.p_gdzie_wiele.text: Under which cup are many acorns? Point to it.

line.p_kubki_nie.text: There is only one acorn here. The many are under the other cup.

line.p_memory.text: Turn the cards and find pairs: one apple with one apple, many apples with many apples.

line.p_cien.text: Whose shadow is it: one pear's or many pears'? Point to it.

line.p_cien_nie.text: Look at the shadow again. Is it one pear, or many?

line.p_cien_jedna.text: Yes! It is the shadow of one pear.

line.p_cien_wiele.text: Yes! It is the shadow of many pears.

line.p_niebo.text: There are many stars in the sky. And what is there only one of? Point to it.

line.p_niebo_nie.text: There are many stars. Look for something there is only one of.

line.p_niebo_ok.text: Yes! There is one moon, and there are many stars.

line.d_uczta.text: The store is home! And now a feast for my friends.

line.d_nakryj.text: Help us lay the table. Put the one cake on the plate, and the many cherries into the bowl.

line.d_pomylka.text: There is one cake, so onto the plate. There are many cherries, so into the bowl.

line.d_gotowe.text: One cake and many cherries. Enjoy!

line.d_rodzice.text: Look around at home with your parents: what do you have one of, and what many of? One table, and many spoons!

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for helping with my store! Here is a sticker for your album. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: These are Squirrel's nuts. She gave them to us when we helped her gather her store and learnt what one and many are.
